notes:
• New - Mandarin OS 0.1.4: a lightweight operating system made only for Mandarin Server, installed from a USB stick, with its own web page (http://mandarin/) to watch over everything. The recommended way to run Mandarin; it updates itself in place and goes back by itself if an update doesn't start
• New - Mandarin on Linux natively (Debian, Ubuntu, Raspberry Pi OS): a one-line installer, the alternative to Mandarin OS
• Changed - Logs always on, on the server, every Mandarin Bridge, every app and the page; Download all logs (Settings → Setup → Logs) gives them as one text file in time order
• Fixed - A large library's backup now restores
• Fixed - MusicBrainz lookups pause while MusicBrainz is turning requests away
• Fixed - A Mandarin Bridge switched on stays on; Mandarin Bridge 0.3.10 updates itself on Linux under systemd
• Fixed - The app pauses between tries when the server can't be reached
